spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento Grid with aggressive asymmetry. Use the 'Grid Borders' pattern.
spacing_and_layout.surface_treatment: Pure sharp edges, completely cardless or raw bordered divs (rounded-none).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment, heavily favoring left-alignment for text, allowing images to span full bleed.

components.hero: Full-bleed background image with heavy black overlay (bg-black/50) or gradient. Use oversized 'Bebas Neue' text layered over the image.
components.product_card: Raw div, no rounded corners. 1px solid border (border-white/10). Aspect square image wrapper. Hover: image scales slightly, border turns to accent color (#FF3300).
components.buttons: Brutalist block buttons. Default: bg-white text-black hover:bg-[#FF3300] hover:text-white transition-all. Sharp corners (rounded-none).
components.marquee: Endless scrolling outline text (text-transparent stroke-white stroke-1 or similar CSS text-stroke effect) for 'NEW DROPS • LIMITED EDITION'.
components.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with 1px bottom border (border-white/10). Simple links.
components.shopping_cart_drawer: Shadcn Sheet component customized with dark theme, sharp corners, and high-contrast checkout button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dark, high-contrast, brutalist streetwear e-commerce site for Sony Music. Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards for products; build raw div layouts with sharp borders (rounded-none). Use Bebas Neue for massive, impactful typography (hero headings, section titles) and Outfit for body copy. Rely heavily on uppercase tracking-[0.2em] for small labels. Accent color is #FF3300 (Signal Red). Implement a marquee ticker for 'NEW DROPS'. All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Use the provided images from the 'media' object for the hero and product catalog. Ensure the design feels gritty, editorial, and culture-driven. Do NOT use any 'placeholder' text for logos or images.
